text.es: Marta: No puedo soportar pensar que sientes por alguien lo mismo que has sentido por mí. Fina: Nunca ha habido, ni habrá nadie en mi vida como tú. Fina: Es tu mano la que quiero que agarre la mía dentro del bolsillo del abrigo. Y es contigo y solo contigo, con quien yo me imagino mi futuro y con quien quiero pasar el resto de noches de mi vida.
text.en: Marta: I can't bear to think that you feel for someone else the same thing you've felt for me. Fina: There has never been, nor will there ever be, anyone in my life like you. Fina: It's your hand that I want to hold mine inside the coat pocket. And it's with you and only you that I imagine my future, and with whom I want to spend the rest of the nights of my life.
